The shipped standard-library checker independently confirms symbolic identities and five exact instances; no infinite claim is inferred solely from sampling.

value.rationale: A natural published infinite family of reduced plane divisors changes splitting exponents in characteristic two from balanced to (d+1,3d+1), while remaining free. The precise excess d^2 in Jacobian length is explained by a complete degeneration from complex nodes to characteristic-two ordinary triple points. Universal explicit derivations make this a structural positive-characteristic phenomenon rather than a numerical curiosity.
